scripts.build: tsc -b packages/provider-http packages/domain-intel packages/rdap packages/registrar packages/registrar-spaceship packages/registrar-namecheap packages/dns-plan packages/cloudflare-dns packages/pangolin-client packages/block-diff packages/messy-table packages/file-delivery packages/write-behind packages/json-redact packages/recurring-costs packages/purelymail-client && bun run build:viewers && bun run build:editor
scripts.build:viewers: tsc -b packages/viewer-core packages/viewer-pdf packages/viewer-model packages/viewer-ecad packages/viewer-lbx packages/viewer-media packages/viewer-markdown packages/viewers && bun scripts/build-viewer-css.ts
scripts.build:editor: tsc -b packages/editor-core packages/editor-renderer packages/editor-react && bun scripts/build-editor-css.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser-test.json && bun run --filter './examples/*' typecheck
scripts.playground: bun run build && bun --cwd examples/editor-playground dev
scripts.verify:packages: bun scripts/verify-packages.ts && bun scripts/verify-viewers.ts && bun scripts/verify-editor.ts
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:examples && bun run verify:packages
